title: Arkret Applet Ghost Actor Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTOs for ak.self.applet.ghost.command.provision. An installed Applet service / bridge submits a complete service-signed accountability Event and delegated Ghost profile Event for one external user. The Principal Server MUST re-check their applet / service / realm / namespace / capability bindings and commit the pair atomically; it MUST NOT mint either proof with a server notary key.

ghost_actor_provision_request_body.description: Request body for ak.self.applet.ghost.command.provision. ghost_actor_id MUST fall inside the actor namespace declared by the applet_id registration; protocol / tenant / external_user_id identify the external principal being mirrored.

accountability_grant_event.description: Complete ak.identity.accountability_grant Event signed by the installed Applet service DID. Its nested accountability proof MUST be signed by the same service identity.

profile_event.description: Complete ak.profile.create Event for ghost_actor_id, delegated and signed by service_id. authorization_ref MUST identify the active ak.applet.ghost.provision capability grant and refs MUST bind the accountability Event.

ghost_actor_provision_outcome.description: Response for ak.self.applet.ghost.command.provision. Carries the durable event refs the Principal Server atomically accepted (or re-confirmed on an identical idempotent replay). authorization_ref is the active Applet provisioning capability grant used by the submitted pair; the accountability grant is not an authorization grant for later Ghost actions.
